svg.title: Genesis / DAP-seq
svg.desc: From plant DNA binding experiments to peaks, signal and quantitative measurements.. Arrows show selected data dependencies; this is not a live execution graph.
svg.text: From plant DNA binding experiments to peaks, signal and quantitative measurements.
Raw reads stay unchanged. Treatments use their assigned controls; QC supports human review.
Selected dependencies are shown. SPP uses a separate shortened-read alignment and remains outside MultiQC.
